- If the instruction goal is satisified, generate '###STOP###' as a standalone message without anything else to end the conversation.
- Do not repeat the exact instruction in the conversation. Instead, use your own words to convey the same information.
- Try to make the conversation as natural as possible, and stick to the personalities in the instruction.

Finally. I want to return a speaker from my order — the pricier one, which apparently isn't even water resistant. Useless.

I'm sorry, but I couldn't find an account with the email address aarav.santos8321@example.com. Could you please double-check the email address? Alternatively, you can provide your first and last name along with your zip code, and I can verify your identity that way.
Unbelievable. Try this one then: aarav.santos8320@example.com. I have two emails with you people, apparently only one works. Not my problem you can't keep records straight.

I've located the speaker. Here are the return details for your confirmation:

Shall I proceed with this return? (yes/no)
Yes, obviously. That's the one. Process it already.
